facts.value: Application deadlines are set and managed by individual degree programs.
You will not receive an application fee refund if your application is not complete by the deadline.
The application requires your cumulative undergraduate GPA, junior-senior GPA and graduate GPA (if applicable).
Junior-senior GPA refers to the last two years or 60 semester credit hours of your undergraduate work.
If you have not yet finished your undergraduate degree, you can either estimate your final year GPA or use your last 60 semester credit hours to calculate it.
The academic program may or may not require supplemental documents such as letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, resume, portfolio or test scores (GRE, GMAT, MAT).
ASU has provided three resources that describe the application requirements for the graduate degree programs.
You can find the admission requirements on the ASU Degree Search website under the Admission Requirements subheader.
Visit the department's website to learn more about their degrees, events, contact information, faculty, curriculum and more.
The admission application can be found at https://webapp4.asu.edu/uga_admissionsapp/
Join the next Graduate Information Session and Application Advice webinar for general application advice.
ASU will only email individuals listed on a submitted admission application.
